architecture.masked_input: one target class token replaced by [MASK]; all other glyphs are frozen-HWR Top-1 predictions
architecture.candidate_policy: original HWR Top-5 only; no token invention, deletion, or regrouping

data_admission.crohme: evaluation-only CC BY-NC transfer diagnostic; zero training or hyperparameter selection
data_admission.external_character_10pct: not applicable to context reranking because rows have no formula sequence or spatial-relation labels
data_admission.direct_canonical_10: replay-only whole-formula rows without verified character ownership; excluded from context accuracy

training.selection: nested formula-disjoint validation inside each writer-LOO fold; lambda=0 is an explicit abstention baseline

direct_writer_loo.scope: 47 project-owned formulas, 211 symbols, three held-writer folds

direct_product_refit_resubstitution.warning: training-set fit only; not acceptance evidence

crohme_transfer.scope: CC BY-NC evaluation only; product refit trained exclusively on project-owned formulae

decision.reason: homograph macro regression or missing project-owned homograph labels; retain as shadow

limitations: Only 47 ownership-verified formulae from three writer groups are available for commercial context training.
The direct folds and CROHME cache were already inspected in earlier experiments and are not untouched final acceptance sets.
Truth grouping is supplied; grouping and final LaTeX/equivalence decoding are outside this reranker evaluation.
